name: Murmansk
notes: The ice-free Arctic port where a small mixed force under British command sat from early 1918 guarding Allied military stores - with, while it stayed defensive, no objection from the Soviet government. At the end of June it turned aggressive and concluded a separate agreement with the Murmansk Soviet, which was not loyal to Moscow.

sources.note: the British force at Murmansk and the agreement with the Murmansk Soviet
